title: The Tool Interface — Why Agents Need Structured I/O

questions.question: Which learning outcome is central to The Tool Interface — Why Agents Need Structured I/O?
options: Explain why an LLM that can only generate text cannot, on its own, take actions against the real world
Skip validation and trust the first plausible-looking output
